cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Story Goal Path Card
cards.goalSkill: connect a fictional boardwalk character want to one snag, first try, rethink, finish note, and pocket label
cards.useCase: Adult-led fictional offline paper-only pocket folder goal path card for a made-up Binding Day Boardwalk story page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one pocket folder, blank page, pencil, and this card beside a pretend boardwalk page stack: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: build a goal path on paper for an invented boardwalk helper and keep every detail made up with adult guidance: ____________________.
cards.wantPrompt: Want: choose what the invented boardwalk helper wants to fix, find, or arrange by the last page: ____________________.
cards.snagPrompt: Snag: name the small boardwalk paper problem that slows the want without danger or blame: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: write the first calm action the helper tries with a page stack, ribbon cart, or folder note: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: show what the helper notices after the first try and what changes on the goal path: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write the ending note that shows how the want changed or was handled: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the broad pretend pocket label for this boardwalk goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill only the want, snag, and pocket label before adding more: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: tuck the page in the pocket folder and add one new rethink later: ____________________.

cards.snagPrompt: Snag: write the small pencil-line problem that blocks the want for one calm story beat: ____________________.
cards.firstTryPrompt: First try: describe the first paper action the helper tries with a pencil mark, chart corner, or folder tab: ____________________.
cards.rethinkPrompt: Rethink: show the new clue the helper notices after the first try changes the goal path: ____________________.
cards.finishNotePrompt: Finish note: write how the helper leaves the chart clearer at the end of the goal path: ____________________.
cards.pocketLabelPrompt: Pocket label: write the broad pretend pocket label for this observatory goal path: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write one want sentence, one snag phrase, and one pocket label word first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: fold the page into the pocket folder and add one invented chart rethink later: ____________________.
